product.description:
Reveal Clearer, Brighter & Healthier-Looking Skin
K-Brightening Face Bar is a powerful, yet gentle cleansing formula designed to enhance your skin’s natural radiance. Enriched with advanced brightening actives and nourishing natural extracts, it helps improve uneven skin tone while keeping the skin soft and balanced.
Infused with Licorice Extract, it soothes redness and irritation while helping defend the skin against environmental stressors. Prickly Pear Extract delivers deep hydration with anti-aging benefits, leaving the skin supple and refreshed. Milk Extract gently exfoliates to remove dull surface cells while strengthening the skin’s natural barrier. Powered by Kojic Acid, this face bar works effectively to visibly reduce dark spots, hyperpigmentation, age spots, and uneven skin tone revealing a clearer, more luminous complexion with regular use.

How to Use:
Lather with water and apply to damp face. Massage gently for a few seconds, then rinse thoroughly. Use daily for best results.
Caution:
For external use only. Avoid contact with eyes. If contact occurs, rinse immediately. Discontinue use if irritation persists. As this product contains Kojic Acid, always apply SPF during the daytime. Keep out of reach of children.
